title: login.notice props, contract version 1
description: The props of the notices above the panel's login form, a data point (PRD 13.4): none. A contribution to it is a translated plain-text notice with a tone, shown in render order; it is data alone, because no addon code runs on a credential page. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Login\Domain\Dto\LoginNoticeV1.
